contentBlocks.body: Practice problem. Clamping keeps a number inside a range: anything below the minimum becomes the minimum, anything above the maximum becomes the maximum. Combine Math.max and Math.min to do it in one expression.
Hint: Math.max(low, value) lifts values up to a floor; Math.min(high, ...) caps them at a ceiling.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Clamp a score so the result is never below 0 or above 100.
